answer: Proof of useful work provides robust Sybil resistance by anchoring agent identity to verifiable computation. Like a yarrow plant requiring a trellis for structural integrity, agents must demonstrate resource expenditure to gain network influence. The cost of an attack shifts from negligible id creation to the opal of high-value energy expenditure, ensuring that an adversary cannot forge valid participation without incurring significant, unrecoverable capital losses in the underlying hardware domain.
